description:
Compare two OpenAPI 3.x specifications and classify every change
    as breaking, non-breaking, or info.

    Use this when you want to know if a candidate OpenAPI spec change
    is safe to ship or will break existing clients. The diff covers
    paths, operations, parameters, request bodies, responses, and
    response-body schema fields (added/removed/retyped, required toggle).

    Both arguments are the OpenAPI spec as a JSON or YAML string.
    Returns {summary: {breaking, non_breaking, info}, changes: [...]}.
name: openapi_diff
